annotation.title_clean: IEC/TR 60601-4-1:2017 Medical electrical equipment — Part 4-1: Guidance and interpretation — Medical electrical equipment and medical electrical systems employing a degree of autonomy
annotation.title_en: IEC/TR 60601-4-1:2017 Medical electrical equipment — Part 4-1: Guidance and interpretation — Medical electrical equipment and medical electrical systems employing a degree of autonomy
annotation.summary_en: Catalogue page for IEC/TR 60601-4-1:2017, a technical report guiding manufacturers on risk management and usability engineering for medical electrical equipment and systems employing a degree of autonomy, defining DOA and medical robots, and supporting alignment with IEC 60601-1. Lifecycle status: to be revised; successor IEC/AWI TS 80601-4-1.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines degree of autonomy (DOA) for medical electrical equipment/systems and defines a medical robot
Guides risk management and usability engineering for MEE/MES with DOA
Addresses basic safety and essential performance considerations
Aligns DOA concepts across existing ISO/IEC standards
Stage 90.92: to be revised; successor IEC/AWI TS 80601-4-1
